item.name: Register Tests
item.description:
**End Point -** [https://practice.expandtesting.com/notes/api/users/register](https://practice.expandtesting.com/notes/api/users/register)

**Method -** <u>POST</u>

**Request Variables -** name, email, password

**Test Scenario - Login Tests**

| **Test Case ID** | **Test Case Description** |
| --- | --- |
| TC-REGISTER-01 | Valid name + email + password |
| TC-REGISTER-02 | Invalid username |
| TC-REGISTER-03 | Invalid email |
| TC-REGISTER-04 | Invalid password |

**Sample Server Response**

1. User Registered
    

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 201,
  "message": "User account created successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 6,
    "name": "practice",
    "email": "practice@expandtesting.com"
  }

 ```

2\. Invalid username

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": 400,
  "message": "User name must be between 4 and 30 characters"
}

 ```

3\. Invalid email

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": 400,
  "message": "A valid email address is required"
}

 ```

4\. Invalid password

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": 400,
  "message": "Password must be between 6 and 30 characters"
}

 ```

item.name: Login Tests
item.description:
**End Point -** [https://practice.expandtesting.com/notes/api/users/login](https://practice.expandtesting.com/notes/api/users/login)

**Method -** <u>POST</u>

**Request Variables -** email and password

**Test Scenario - Login Tests**

| **Test Case ID** | **Test Case Description** |
| --- | --- |
| TC-LOGIN-01 | Valid email + Valid password |
| TC-LOGIN-02 | Invalid credentials |
| TC-LOGIN-03 | Empty email |
| TC-LOGIN-04 | Empty password |

**Sample Server Response**

1. Invalid credentials
    

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": 401,
  "message": "Incorrect email address or password"
}

 ```

2\. Valid credentials

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Login successful",
  "data": {
    "id": "64189a74314e9f0218a5213c",
    "email": "practice@expandtesting.com",
    "name": "practice",
    "token": "728eb6906b0a4e83a7d789a0da9801..."
  }
}

 ```

3\. Empty email

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": 400,
  "message": "A valid email address is required"
}

 ```

4\. Empty password

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": 400,
  "message": "Password must be between 6 and 30 characters"
}

 ```
